verdict.rationale: Bento's marketing says every release is scored against production history 'offline, in CI, and on live traffic' to catch regressions before users do. Its CLI is documented as usable from CI with JSON output. There is no documentation of how to configure CI evals or how a failing score blocks a deployment, so the gating half rests on an implied claim. missing for 10: CI eval setup docs (pipeline config, commands), an explicit deployment-gating mechanism such as thresholds or non-zero exit codes, eval dataset definition, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results

citations.quote: Every release scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic. Catches regressions before users do.
Anything you can do in the dashboard, you can do from your terminal, a script, or CI
